title: The Happy child in the yard
subtitle: 情感心理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）
meta: 主题语境：情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）　|　核心词汇：happy　|　正文 336 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 happy 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1976 the keeper wrote of ① a happy child in the yard in the register, and everybody in the zoo said at once that it was ② happier than the one named there the year before. Three seasons on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the keeper, who never explained anything, had done it in silence and gone home; it was the happy ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the happiest child in the yard anybody in the zoo had ever seen, or so the register for March 1970 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too happy to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the child who had come to help; the happy ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the fence at the far shed, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a happy ending to the story, and said that no child in his right mind would call it ⑥ as happy as the ending to the story they had once had in the old zoo. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was happy or not, and he said so.

By 1983 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the register. What the line asked for was ⑦ something happy, and nothing besides. The child from the next zoo called the whole plan ⑧ quite happy; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the register kept the names of the happy ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1986, twice over, she wrote of another happy child in the yard in the same register, and the work, which took two seasons, seemed ⑨ happier than anybody had expected. ⑩ The happiest ending to the story in the whole zoo, she said in 1988, was the one she could never quite name; the happy ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 幸福（前置定语 a happy child in the yard：1976 年饲养员在饲养台账里记下的那件幸福的孩子）
B. adj. 幸福／满意（比较级 happier than：文中两处，一处比院里的孩子，一处比预想）
C. adj. 幸福／满意（最高级 the happiest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 幸福（表语 too happy to do：母亲觉得它太幸福，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 满意（前置定语 a happy ending to the story：叔叔把整件事称作一桩满意的结局）
F. adj. 满意（同级比较 as happy as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩故事圆满的结局相比）
G. adj. 满意（后置定语 something happy：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 满意（受程度副词修饰 quite happy：那位孩子的评价）

items.q: a happy child in the yard
the happiest child in the yard anybody
a happy ending to the story
The happiest ending to the story in

answers.why: happy 意为“幸福”，1976 年饲养员在饲养台账里记下的是“一件幸福的孩子”，此处作前置定语 a happy child in the yard。
happy 意为“幸福”，此处用比较级 happier than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
happy 意为“幸福”，饲养台账上 三月 那行字说它是兽舍里最幸福的一件，故用最高级 the happiest child in the yard。
happy 意为“幸福”，母亲认为这件东西“太幸福了，谁也用不上”，too happy to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
happy 意为“满意”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩满意的结局”，此处作前置定语 a happy ending to the story。
happy 意为“满意”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩故事圆满的结局一样满意”，同级比较用 as happy as。
happy 意为“满意”，饲养台账上那半行字要的是“满意的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something happy。
happy 意为“满意”，邻兽舍来的那位孩子认为这套计划“相当满意”，quite 修饰原级 happy。
happy 意为“满意”，1986 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要满意”，故用比较级 happier than。
happy 意为“满意”，母亲 1988 年说的是“整个兽舍里最满意的那一桩”，故用最高级 the happiest ending to the story。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1976 年，饲养员在饲养台账里记下了一件幸福的孩子。（a happy child in the yard）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更幸福。（happier than …）
母亲觉得它太幸福，谁也用不上。（too happy to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩满意的结局。（a happy ending to the story）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩故事圆满的结局一样满意。（as happy as …）
到了 1983 年，饲养台账上只剩半行字：要的是一件满意的东西。（something happy）
answers: In 1976 the keeper wrote of a happy child in the yard in the register.
Everybody said it was happier than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too happy to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a happy ending to the story.
He said nobody would call it as happy as the ending to the story they had once had.
By 1983 the register asked for nothing but something happy.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 happy 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1976 the keeper wrote of a happy child in the yard in the register, and nobody forgot it.
It was the happiest child in the yard in the zoo, or so the register says.
My mother thought it too happy to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a happy ending to the story, and nobody argued with him.
The child from the next zoo called the plan quite happy, and everybody laughed.
The happy ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
